title: WebGPUPathTracer: Remaining features
body:
Migrating the list of remaining work for WebGPUPathTracer from https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-gpu-pathtracer/pull/713 to a dedicated issue. cc @TheBlek feel free to edit and anything you think should be worked on / mark if you're planning to / ark working on something.

## Initial Release
### Material Features
- Punctual Lights (Directional, Point Lights) (`webgpu/lights` branch)
- Area Lights  (`webgpu/lights` branch)
- IES Spotlight Profiles (`webgpu/ies` branch)
- Shadow cast toggle (skip shadow rays from MIS only?)
- Unlit support (only unlit on primary / transmissive / specular ray)
- [EON](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.18026) support

### Validation
- Fix handling of ior = 1.0 or reflection, improve bookkeeping of f90 on the surface record and stop assuming 1.0
  - Setting ior to 1.0 can seemingly cause NaN errors
- Fix "stable noise" so it reliably gives consistent results across loads / renders

### Performance
- Improve "low res mode" rendering performance
  - Limit bounces
  - Limit samples per pixel for wavefront

### Demos
- Update demo models
  - Bitterli Rendering Resources - renderer test scenes (Veach MIS, Veach bidir), Mitsuba/pbrt/Tungsten
  - Poly Haven - CC0 models, textures, matching HDRIs
  - Blend Swap - CC-licensed .blend, origin of many Bitterli scenes
  - Blender demo files - blender.org/download/demo-files
  - Sketchfab - widest variety, filter CC + downloadable, exports glTF directly
  - NVIDIA ORCA - Lumberyard Bistro, Emerald Square; large properly-authored PBR
  - Intel Sponza - Sponza with materials actually authored for PBR
  - Fab (absorbed Quixel Megascans) - scanned PBR assets, account required
  - Smithsonian Open Access / threedscans.com - CC0 scans, dense geometry, dull materials
  - Pixar teapot (https://renderman.pixar.com/official-swatch)
  - ASWF ALab - full production USD shot
  - Look development-studio - https://renderman.pixar.com/look-development-studio
  - Magic shop assets - https://renderman.pixar.com/magic-shop-asset
- Clean up demos
  - Remove as many options as possible in most demos
  - Improve scene / camera position quality
  - Remove unneeded HDRI
  - Find a "Hero" model
- Improved scenes
- Update photos
- Simplify demo options
- Fix / remove remaining demos
  - Fog (depends on new feature)
  - AO Render (depends on new feature) (remove?)

### Other
- JSDoc Documentation

## Next Priority
### Features
- Emissive material CDF, NEE
- Fog
- Subsurface Scattering
  - would be best to support a per-object walk? But it's difficult with clustering?
- [Manifold Next Event Estimation (MNEE)](https://jo.dreggn.org/home/2015_mnee.pdf) (caustics)
- Dispersion

### Performance
- Consider splitting the opaque dielectric specular & metallic lobes 
- Only create a single BVHComputeData instance and change the scene
- "Any hit" raycast function for shadow rays
- Investigate impact of better GGX VNDF algorithms:
  - https://arxiv.org/pdf/2306.05044
  - https://gpuopen.com/download/Bounded_VNDF_Sampling_for_Smith-GGX_Reflections.pdf

### Tools
- Command Line renderer (@TheBlek)
- Benchmark tool (@TheBlek)

## Future
- R3F component
- Cycles-like beveled edge support
- Use a CDF (possibly per hit) for light selection
- Tessellation + displacement (preprocess step)
- Low res image seems "brighter" possibly due to over 1.0 linear color bilinear interpolation.
- [FidelityFX Upscaler](https://github.com/pmndrs/upscaler)
- Add easy debug mechanism for intermediate values
- [OIDN Denoiser](https://x.com/DennisSmolek/status/2073063206956986453)
  - Requires rendering out an albedo, normal texture (related [three.js issue](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/issues/33175))
- Custom lobes?
  - Layers
  - Custom layers
- "Volume" stack for tracking current mediums (eg ior, fog, etc)
- High quality bloom, flare / glare / ghosting / chromatic etc effects
- Emissive mesh / triangle NEE sampling
- Use sheen LTC lobe (used in OpenPBR)
  - https://tizianzeltner.com/projects/Zeltner2022Practical/
- "khronos-recursiveskeletons" fails to load / crashes context (three.js issue)
- Improved energy conservation methods for bi directional path tracing
- Try SBVH, improved GPU packing
- [ZSobol](https://pbr-book.org/4ed/Sampling_and_Reconstruction/Sobol_Samplers#BlueNoiseSobolrsquoSampler) Sampler
- Bidirectional path tracing
- Custom material definitions
- Variance detection / completion
- GPU BVH generation, refit
- Concurrent ray handling in Wavefront mode
  - Requires accumulating rays in a single kernel to avoid concurrent writes
- Spectral path tracing
- Motion blur
- Improved physical camera modeling (distortion, anamorphic, physically accurate modeling)
- Add support for camera film gate - how to handle two different aspect ratios (canvas vs film?)
- Improved HDR env map layout for sampling (see [#339](https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-gpu-pathtracer/issues/339))
- Strip tangents if unused
- Compressed Wide BVH
  - https://users.aalto.fi/~laines9/publications/ylitie2017hpg_paper.pdf
